newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-George Weston aims for profit growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-George Weston aims for profit growth.

text.p: Bakery group George Weston Foods Ltd said on Tuesday it aimed to steadily increase profits over the medium term.
"The outlook is for a continuing fairly steady increase in profitability," chief executive and deputy chairman John Pascoe told reporters.

Asked if the company's profit growth would be similar to that achieved in 1995/96, Pascoe said the company aimed to increase its net profit before abnormals at double the prevailing rate of inflation.
The company, which is 78 percent owned by Associated British Foods Plc, achieved a 4.9 percent rise in 1995/96 (August/July) net profit to A$54.08 million.
Pascoe earlier told shareholders at the annual meeting that trading was in line with budget estimates in the early part of the current year despite a flat retail market.
